results.name: current tab: id, url, title, supported
all tabs listed, exactly one active, browser state overview
inspect page: structure, roles, shadow DOM, iframe, hidden file input
read visible text: viewport vs whole page
navigate: load, redirect flag, hash change, failure is reported
tabs: open, switch (id and match), close, last-tab protection
back / forward / no history
click: buttons, links, new-tab links, overlays, shadow DOM, custom widgets, coordinates
type: replace/append, keys mode, textarea, contenteditable, password masking, iframe
select / check / uncheck / radio
scroll: by amount, to bottom/top, limits, element into view
screenshot: PNG/JPEG saved locally, background tab activated
upload from authorized folder via file input (no debugger)
detect page/navigation changes: events, SPA route, dialogs, downloads
verify + wait: pass, fail, timeout, polling
STALE_ELEMENT: superseded, detached, changed, document replaced, unknown id
press_key: Enter submits, Tab moves focus, typing keys, risk tag
risk tags attached to responses (not enforced in Phase 1)
unsupported Chrome pages are rejected, never reported as success
side panel shows live status, task and restricted-page warning
downloaded file can be saved only into an authorized folder
reconnect: agent restart is survived without touching the browser
find_text: jump to text near the bottom of a long page; context, element ids, hidden content, secrets, frames; stale rules intact
every response is structured; logs have required fields and no secrets
